mapper.select: SELECT cart_id AS cartId, member_id AS memberId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM CART WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT CI.cart_item_id AS cartItemId, CI.cart_id AS cartId, CI.product_id AS productId, CI.package_id AS packageId, CI.quantity AS quantity, CI.created_at AS createdAt, IFNULL(P.product_name, PK.package_name) AS productName, IFNULL(P.price, PK.package_price) AS price FROM CART_ITEM CI LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON CI.product_id = P.product_id LEFT JOIN PACKAGE PK ON CI.package_id = PK.package_id WHERE CI.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY CI.cart_item_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CART_ITEM SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART ( member_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, NOW(), NOW() )
INSERT INTO CART_ITEM ( cart_id, product_id, quantity, created_at ) VALUES ( #{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE CART_ITEM SET quantity = quantity + #{quantity} WHERE cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
